notes: Their main damage was Greystone (26k physical); 2/5 of us itemized armor.
Enemy ran 4/5 on or near their meta core — they drafted and built optimally; match it.

coaching.headline: Eleven won fights to their zero — Murdock 16/2 and Gideon 15/3 — and the only blemish is that just two of those wins were cashed into objectives.
coaching.team: Four of five lane reads were favored and the team delivered on every one, then stacked the map: Mini Prime at 11 and 18, Fangtooth at 17, Primal Fangtooth at 22, Genesis Core at 23 and 30, Orb Prime at 24 and 30, with objective damage 93,200 to their 14,307. The leak worth remembering is the early Fangtooths — the 6-minute one went to them as a cross-map trade while we won the 5.8 fight 2-0, and the 12-minute one followed the 5-5 scrap at our Mini Prime — and a 2-of-11 fight-to-objective conversion is why a total stomp still ran 32 minutes.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 3-1 teamfight at our Primal Fangtooth at 21.4 opened the 22-to-24 window where Primal Fangtooth, Genesis Core and Orb Prime all fell in three minutes — the game was decided there.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Murdock ran the cleanest carry game on file: 16/2/7 with 30905 objective damage, and the enemy support dead to him five times. The winning core landed on schedule — Lightning Hawk at 12, Vanquisher at 19, Imperator at 25 — and the two deaths were the whole cost.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Steel owned the vision game — 19 wards placed — while going 4/2/15 and winning the support matchup late exactly as read. The 27.6 note applies to him too: ahead in lane while a 4v5 scrapped at their Primal Fangtooth; the shove-and-rotate turns that 1-1 into a clean win.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Khaimera was the objective engine — a match-high 43203 objective damage with the jungle read won all game. The drills are the quiet ones: 14540 hero damage and only 3 wards; in fights he was the fifth man, not the threat, and vision would make his early pathing safer.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 2 times in 32 minutes, fewer deaths than about 90% of Murdock carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Long Arm of the Law at rank 3: 95s base, about 79.2s by the end (17% shorter) from 20 ability haste: Nuclear Rounds 20.
Murdock dealt 36,611 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +227 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Dekker (level 16: about 169 physical armor, 115 after penetration; took 14,140 physical damage from heroes, 68% of all hero damage they took) and Revenant (level 16: about 104 physical armor, 66 after penetration; took 10,083 physical damage from heroes, 54% of all hero damage they took) that is about 25% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Nuclear Rounds (item): Based on Critical Strike Chance: Increase Ability Damage by 10-20%.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Ranged Basic Attack: Fire 2 additional projectiles. Each deals 10-35% (increases with Range) () Damage. Can Critically Strike and apply Lifesteal.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Melee Heroes only: Increase your Total Critical Strike Chance by 25%. Gain 1% Damage Mitigation for every 10% Missing Health.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Sustain: 14% lifesteal; 2,404 healing recorded.

Lesson: Murdock's penetration cut through: Dekker took about 25% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 16 their armor was about 169, about 115 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).

Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.) Field: 52.2% in 4108 games, 39% of picks, above the hero-role's 49%.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,226 hero damage a minute, more than 83% of Gideon mid players this patch (29% of the team's). The damage came from Wraith Leggings, Combustion, Caustica.
Black Hole at rank 3: 105s base, about 89s by the end (15% shorter) from 18 ability haste: Azure Core 10, Soulbearer 8.
Gideon dealt 39,217 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +480 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11, Combustion 9, Caustica ignores 35%; against Boris (level 16: about 56 magical armor, 16 after penetration; took 17,455 magical damage from heroes, 54% of all hero damage they took) and Iggy & Scorch (level 17: about 47 magical armor, 11 after penetration; took 16,962 magical damage from heroes, 63% of all hero damage they took) that is about 34% and 33% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.

Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 3,719 healing recorded.

Lesson: Gideon's penetration cut through: Boris took about 34% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 16 their armor was about 56, about 16 after 20 flat + 35% penetration).

Loadout augment Infinite Impact: Void Breach flies across the map, so you can snipe low targets or poke from very far away. Great for finishing fleeing enemies. (game text: Void Breach has infinite range.) (changes Void Breach, 7.6s cooldown with their haste) Field: 48.2% in 5942 games, 59% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.5%.

Loadout crest Soulbearer: A shield plus magic healing and movement speed. Pop it before a fight to survive the dive and heal off your Cosmic Rift and Black Hole damage. (game text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.) Field: 51.7% in 6993 games, 70% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.5%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Wraith Leggings, Combustion, Caustica. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 18 ability haste brought them back 15% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Gideon killed built magical armor (Dekker). Anti-heal on Boris. We killed Gideon 3 times.
Copy it? this 3-item core: 52.2% in 2,210 games, level with the 52.2% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
